title: Cleaning up agent processes when Obeya or its supervisor dies
text: We looked at running each agent behind a small supervisor that stops the agent and everything it started when Obeya dies. Obeya in turn stops them if the supervisor dies. The two faults that blocked a first attempt are fixed and tested on macOS and Linux. Neither side helps when both die at once, and Windows needs another approach. So this stays a prototype for now and will be combined with a crash-recovery registry later.
